title: a4keys.com — Wholesale Pricing Management Website
tagline: Zero-downtime migration with custom wholesale pricing plugin
intro: WordPress site migrated with no downtime and enhanced with a custom pricing plugin for bulk orders.
summary: Delivered a host migration across providers without service disruption. Implemented a WordPress plugin to manage wholesale pricing logic and maintained the platform long term.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A wholesale/retail WordPress platform enhanced for bulk pricing and migrated seamlessly to a new host.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Introduce robust wholesale pricing and complete a risk-free migration with no business disruption.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Executed the full migration, authored the wholesale pricing plugin, and provided long-term maintenance.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Simplified bulk order management and improved platform stability.
